question: Can tracing the existing static four-phase source register produce a deterministic interacting matter evolution, and how can true reduced four-point non-Gaussianity be distinguished from a coherent quartic Hamiltonian?
summary_de: Der inklusive Trace des unveraenderten statischen v1033-Vierphasenregisters ergibt bei Produktpraeparation eine Mischung bedingter Entwicklungen. Auf der vollen Materiealgebra ist sie genau dann unitaer, wenn alle besetzten Zweige phasenproportional sind; beim bedingten quadratischen Fock-Lift bleibt jeder solche deterministische Ausgang gausssch. An Originalmatrizen: Reinheit 1-t^2 und Wick-Defekt -t^2/2 in zweiter Ordnung fuer eine ausdruecklich gewaehlte Einteilchenpraeparation. Nichtgausssches Readout beweist hier keinen quartischen Hamiltonvertex. Vollstaendige Quellenantwort, korrelierte Codes und Herkunft bleiben getrennt offen.
assumptions: Unchanged block-diagonal v1033 source Hamiltonian and a fixed initial product register-matter state
Inclusive register trace and the full same matter algebra, rather than a selected code or neutral subalgebra
Fermion statement conditional on C4 tensor Fock(V) with quadratic dGamma branch Hamiltonians
Explicit diagnostic nx=3, ny=1, equal register populations and one seam particle; not a selected vacuum
kills: Infer a coherent quartic matter Hamiltonian merely from nonzero four-point cumulants after a static phase-register trace
Infer a new deterministic non-Gaussian full-CAR unitary from a mixture of static Gaussian unitary branches
Treat a final unconditioned register-only reset as removing the matter mixing
Present the already archived native pair-Casimir identity as a newly derived P1/P2 source interaction
leaves_open: Full-source charged shift responses, which can be nontrivial although phase projectors are conserved
Correlated encoded infrared sectors and controlled approximate effective dynamics
Source-selected phase-changing dynamics or nonquadratic branch interactions
Microscopic field, charge, state and time maps between compiler, rotor and boundary sources
Complete 3+1D relativistic chiral dynamics and gravity
not_claimed: No universal no-go for emergent interaction or for TFPT
No claim that a mixture of Gaussian states is Gaussian
No selected register preparation, Fock lift, physical time scale or vacuum
Standard quantum-channel mathematics is not claimed as new
